title: Sukkah 6b — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 6 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-006.htm), questions 4–6.

questions.q: "Miuto she'eino makpid" (an interposition covering a minority of the body, that one doesn't mind) is chotzetz (invalidates immersion).
options: Gazru (the Rabbis decreed it) because of miuto ha'makpid (minority, minded)
Gazru because of rubo she'eino makpid (majority, not minded)
questions.explain: The Gemara explicitly declines to extend the rabbinic decree this far — stacking a decree on a decree. Minority-not-minded stays uninvalidating even rabbinically.

questions.q: How many walls does a sukkah need?
questions.explain: The Rabbis hold two full walls plus a token third (3 total); Rabbi Shimon holds three full walls plus a token fourth (4 total) — a genuine machloket, not a single agreed number.

questions.q: A verse is read one way and written another (yesh eim la'mikra vs. yesh eim la'masoret) — which governs?
questions.explain: This is exactly the root machloket between the Rabbis (written/masoret governs) and Rabbi Shimon (read/mikra governs) over the sukkah's wall count — genuinely disputed, not resolved to one method.
